name: Izakaya WA
tagline: Houston's first and only Japanese-owned izakaya.
description: Izakaya WA is Houston's first and only Japanese-owned and operated izakaya. Traditional small plates, sushi, robata-grilled skewers and sake, served in the spirit of wa — harmony.

footer.blurb: Houston's first and only Japanese-owned izakaya. Traditional small plates, sushi, robata and sake, served in the spirit of 和 — harmony.
footer.note: Hours, menu and pricing are subject to change — please call to confirm before your visit.
